gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (printed p17) Transfers to other funds: only the Debt Service Fund column (3,673) = Total (3,673); in detail as index 54 (-3,673, Debt Service budget schedule p13). The General Fund departments combining statement p14 prints a transfer between departments of the General Fund: General (27,000) (detail index 37) and Library 27,000 (detail index 38, Transfers In), which net to zero inside the General Fund and are not shown on the governmental funds statement (General Fund column prints no transfer). Schedule 3,673 + 27,000 = 30,673 vs statement 3,673; the remaining 27,000 is exactly this printed intra-fund departmental transfer. It is printed, so it stays; no fix.

Proprietary funds statement p7 (printed p20), Water Fund and Sewer Fund columns have no schedule and no detail lines. JSON business-type receipts = operating revenues + interest income + grant income (357,525). Water Fund: Sales 135,579 + Other revenue 2,787 + Grant income 67,494 = 205,860; Sewer Fund: Sales 147,348 + Other revenue 4,099 + Interest income 218 = 151,665. Sum 357,525 = statement total; schedule 0 + 357,525 = 357,525.
